title: Langley Pushes to Lift Old Airspace Limits Restricting Building Heights

seo.Title: Langley Pushes to Lift Old Airspace Limits Restricting Building Heights
seo.Meta description: Langley Mayor Nathan Pachal urges Ottawa to update 1970s airspace rules that cap buildings at 15 storeys, blocking new high-rise housing near future SkyTrain stations.
